findings.title: Task 3.2a's "full core suite passes" gate cannot pass — tests of the removed rendering still exist
findings.description:
3.1 removes the `Comprehension:` line from `SectionBuilder` and 3.2 removes the Adoption Facts section from `ContextTemplateEngine`, but 3.2a's Success criterion is `pnpm --filter @context-forge/core test` — the whole core suite. Two still-present files assert exactly the removed rendering:
- `packages/core/tests/pipeline-integration.test.ts`, describe "brownfield build with an injected squadron probe": "available probe … → the JSON block and the line are in the prompt" and "unavailable probe → the statement carries the reason" assert the probe text that only the Adoption Facts section rendered, and "comprehension document present → Comprehension line in Project Context" asserts the `Comprehension:` line. All three fail after 3.1/3.2.
- `packages/core/tests/adoption/adoptionBuild.integration.test.ts` cases 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 13 use `expectBrownfield`, which requires `### Adoption Facts`. They fail after 3.2.
The file is deleted/edited only later (3.3 for `pipeline-integration.test.ts`, 4.1 for `adoptionBuild.integration.test.ts`). Either name those files in 3.1/3.2 (delete or temporarily skip the affected cases), or scope 3.2a's check to `SectionBuilder ContextTemplateEngine`, as 3.1 and 3.2 already do.

findings.title: Task 3.7's `pnpm -r test` gate cannot pass — `adoptionBuild.integration.test.ts` survives until 4.1
findings.description: 3.3 changes `createContextPipeline` to one argument and updates `ContextIntegrator.test.ts`, `CoreServiceFactory.test.ts`, `pipeline-integration.test.ts` and `pure-build-golden.test.ts`, but not `packages/core/tests/adoption/adoptionBuild.integration.test.ts`, which calls `createContextPipeline(dir, { adoptionStateWrites, squadronProbe: fakeProbe })` (line 68) and drives 13 brownfield expectations through it. After 3.3 the extra argument is ignored, no resolver is wired, and that file fails; it is deleted only in 4.1. So 3.7's Success ("`pnpm -r build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm -r test` … all four pass") is false as written. Move the deletion of `adoptionBuild.integration.test.ts` into 3.3 (it is a test of the removed seam), or state in 3.7 that this one file is expected to fail until 4.1 and that 3.7's gate is the filtered run plus build/lint/typecheck.

findings.title: Commit markers are checkbox items, not plain `**Commit**:` lines; placement is sound
findings.description: The file marks commits as checklist items (`- [ ] **2.3 Commit** — …`, `- [ ] Commit: …`) rather than plain `**Commit**:` lines. AGENTS.md requires a `[ ]` checkbox on every item and subitem, so this is consistent with project convention; no action needed. Placement is at working, tested points: 2.3 after the golden test passes on unmodified source, 3.2a after typecheck plus a scoped test run, 3.7 after the full pass, each 4.x after typecheck/test, 5.1 after the purity test, with no commit at the very end and no merge/push task (Phase 7 owns that, as the design requires).
